title: The day before
logline: The day before Thanksgiving: Gully's shut early, a paper sign on the door the page doesn't letter, the ramp swept, the lawn chair with a tarp over it. Nobody. The page's holiday is the tarp.

panels.composition: A shingle bait shack shut with a paper sign taped inside the door, the plank ramp swept, an old lawn chair on the dock with a tarp tied over it, gray afternoon.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle bait shack shut with a paper sign taped inside the door, a swept plank ramp and an old lawn chair on the dock with a tarp tied over it, gray afternoon, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
